summary: Iter-11 comprehensive QA — backend pytest 188/188 PASS, backtester runs cleanly, frontend admin flow verified end-to-end (dashboard, /bot, /trades, /analytics, /affiliate, /notifications). All STOIC AI features specified in the review brief are present and functional. No critical bugs found. A few testid/text-naming inconsistencies between the review brief and the actual implementation were noted — implementation is correct; the brief used outdated names (see context_for_next_testing_agent).

minor.issue: When test_webhook_invalid_signature_returns_400 sends a malformed webhook, the third-party emergentintegrations library raises KeyError('type') which we catch and convert to a 400 — exception trace is logged at ERROR level in backend.err.log. Pytest passes. Cosmetic: consider catching the KeyError inside subscription_service and logging at WARNING level so the err.log stays cleaner during regression runs.

integration_issues.issue: Two transient 401s appear in console immediately after login — caused by /api/auth/me being called before the access_token cookie has finished propagating. UI recovers on next render and the user sees a normal session. Harmless but noisy; could be suppressed by gating the initial /me call behind the login completion promise.

action_items: [INFO / brief-mismatch] The review brief expects these testids that DO NOT exist in the codebase (the components do exist with different testid names): risk-thermometer (→ stat-open-live-pnl), risk-closest-sl (→ closest-sl), risk-closest-tp (→ closest-tp), max_spread_pips-{SYM} (→ spread-cap-{SYM}), max_slippage_pips-{SYM} (→ slippage-cap-{SYM}). Either update the brief or rename the testids in /app/frontend/src/pages/Trades.jsx (lines 131, 139, 149) and /app/frontend/src/pages/BotConfig.jsx (lines 378, 415) to match the brief — your call. Functionality is correct either way.

[POLISH] /app/frontend/src/pages/BotConfig.jsx — the section header reads 'SECTION 05 · TRADING INTELLIGENCE' (uppercase only); not a bug, but if you want substring matches like 'Trading Intelligence' to find it for testing/marketing, render the actual word once in the title.
[MINOR] subscription_service.handle_stripe_webhook stack-trace from the deliberate-invalid-signature pytest case ends up in backend.err.log as ERROR. Consider catching KeyError + logging at WARNING.

Backtester (`python -m backtester.run BTCUSD --bars 90`) runs cleanly: 90-bar BTCUSD backtest produces final_equity=$10047.24, total_pnl=$47.24, 4 trades (2W/2L), win_rate=50%, max_drawdown=0.86%, macro_pit_delay=1500ms. No tracebacks.

Frontend Dashboard (/) shows BOT STATUS strip (data-testid=bot-status-strip) with WHY-NO-TRADE banner ('Bot is stopped — start it from Bot Config'), VETOES TODAY (24H) row with `intel-slippage·14` badge — only counters >0 render (per spec 'Intelligence Counters row shows when total>0'). All 7 categories (mtf_veto, auto_tune_block, spread_block, slippage_veto, learned_meta_veto, aplus_veto, rr_veto) are wired in backend (pytest TestIntelligenceCounters confirms) — UI only shows the non-zero ones, which is correct UX.

Per-symbol pip-cap inputs are conditionally rendered when the parent toggle is ON (spread-cap-{SYM} inside [data-testid=spread-caps], slippage-cap-{SYM} inside [data-testid=slippage-caps]). Correct UX pattern — no point editing caps for a disabled filter. Backend persist confirmed by TestSpreadFilter.test_bot_config_roundtrip_spread_fields and TestSlippageVeto.test_bot_config_roundtrip_slippage.

Frontend /trades — header order verified: SYMBOL, SIDE, LOTS, ENTRY, CURRENT, SL, TP, EXIT, LIVE P&L, P&L, OPENED, CLOSED, STATUS. 'OPEN LIVE P&L' stat (data-testid=stat-open-live-pnl) renders the aggregate. RiskThermometer subdisplay inside the same card emits closest-sl + closest-sl-eta and closest-tp + closest-tp-eta with $-distance + symbol + 'X min' ETA (lines 129-162 of Trades.jsx). All math (BUY: current-entry, SELL: entry-current, * lot * CONTRACT_SIZE[symbol]) is correct. NOTE: the testids the brief referenced (risk-thermometer / risk-closest-*) do not exist — the actual testids are stat-open-live-pnl / closest-sl / closest-tp / closest-{sl,tp}-eta. Functionality is correct, naming is just different.

Frontend /analytics — data-testid=learned-meta-card AND data-testid=auto-tune-card both render; data-testid=learned-meta-retrain button is present and clickable. Performance Attribution dimensional breakdowns ('Attribution' text matched) still render.

Signal payload — TestSignalDualAIShape, TestSignalPayloadNewFieldsLive (iter-4), TestSignalPayloadIter5Live (macro+upcoming_macro), TestIter6SignalPayload, TestRRandAdaptiveSLTP all confirm the 9-veto cascade emits kalman_filter / cot_positioning / real_yield_10y / learned_meta / aplus_confluence (with passed/score/max/min_required/checks/reason) / rr_ratio / veto_applied. No frontend-rendered hole observed.
ai_signals.py (449 lines) — borderline at the 700-line code-review threshold but still maintainable; the 9-veto cascade is well-segmented. Will need a split if a 10th veto is ever added.

Two background 401s on initial dashboard mount (CON-ERR in playwright console capture) — almost certainly /api/auth/me racing the cookie set. Doesn't break the UI; consider deferring the first /me until React Router has resolved the redirect.
